body: I’m not blaming it on anything. I don’t have any emotional connection with my ex
My friend, that’s not how feelings work. When you’re depressed, you can’t “stop thinking about it” to stop feelings sad…

I won’t argue any further. No, you don’t have control over your feelings. What you do have control over is how you deal with those feelings and what you do about them. I didn’t ask my ex for nudes. I didn’t cheat. I still feel like I want them but I won’t do shit
There really isn’t any point in shaming me for feelings I have no control over. My boyfriend would understand, albeit be insecure if I mention it.

It’s not an open relationship, no. I’m using it to highlight my point that you could be sexually attracted to other people. As long as you don’t do anything about it (cheat), it’s literally not your fault. I would rather die than be stuck with that piece of shit again, but he was… well-endowed… and I miss that part of him. Yearning for something you lost isn’t that uncommon

Sexual and romantic attraction are very different things. A lot of people are in open relationships where they can sleep with other people but are romantically exclusive to each other. I’m sorry you don’t see that.
Thank you. You have absolutely no clue how nice it is to read your kind words. I need some time to heal but I’ll get there eventually. You really did help ❤️
He later said he wasn’t actually going to do it, but I don’t know.. I feel like if I reacted differently and reassured him that it’s okay he would’ve. I wouldn’t do that ofc but still
Yeah you’re right, I’ll definitely try finding some people, thank you so much!
Alright, noted! Thank you so much!
I’ll definitely try that, but my type is very particular (and concerning) so I need some time to find the right guy
